title: Real life location I have totally seen in my dreams
content: Yep, had a very vivid dream in which I was looking for teaching work and wound up joining this church while a potluck was in progress. The exterior was painted white, but the trim was the same, and I went inside that white door to help clean up the kitchen. Approximately 500 miles from where I live, I’ve never been there, and it’s currently up for sale. But basically I stood on that little patch of lawn while people carried lawn chairs and coolers in and out of the door.
